summary: The governing source clarifies that selected enrollment comes from the authenticated binding while complete unfiltered native memberships retain historical/deferred, unexpected, unresolved and pending-intake distinctions. An expected total cannot replace reconciliation; visible extras are neither silently dropped nor automatically enrolled. Roadmap, classification, parent and Status joins use typed native values rather than body wording. Useful intake, admitted enrollment and disjoint preparation can advance during unrelated CI/runtime waits; capacity and effect admission apply to the actual operation, while protected enrollment still precedes board-selected implementation. Admission, reservation and request share exact stable sliceId/attempt/operation/owner/PR/head/path values and preserve relevant known/Unknown holds. Final input bytes/hashes are frozen before a failure-gated preflight and invocation; changed bytes invalidate that candidate and any failure prevents later launch lines. Original refusals, partial effects and uncertain outcomes retain identity and custody without blind retry or replacement identity. This is finite cooperative source guidance, not atomic/server-CAS behavior, native authority, runtime acceptance, fleet adoption or a measured throughput improvement. The source adds no packet, ledger, scheduler or approval layer.
title: Typed intake population and frozen operation handoff preserve independent progress
